title: English Practice Quiz 0696
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: I have ___ friends in this city.
questions.explanation: A few is used with countable plural nouns.

questions.question: Listen! The baby ___.
questions.explanation: Listen! suggests an action happening now, so use the present continuous.

questions.question: He wants to become ___ engineer.
questions.explanation: Engineer begins with a vowel sound, so use an.

questions.question: Which word has a silent 'k'?
questions.explanation: The k in know is silent.

questions.question: Choose the correctly written date phrase.
questions.explanation: Days of the week begin with a capital letter.
